note: Full-field audits recompute the reported full-grid error exactly. Sub-grid audits recompute exactly the in-job strided sub-grid error from the saved strided field and an independent SciPy reference; for reduced arms (smooth error) the full-grid and sub-grid error values must also agree within 5%. CG arms have rough error fields, so their full-grid error is audited exactly only where full fields are saved.
